 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order
% 19.10.2023 CM APPL. 54689/2023 (for condonation of delay)
1. This is an application filed under Section 5 of the Limitation Act, 1963 seeking condonation of delay in filing the present appeal.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, delay of 30 days in filing the present appeal stands condoned.
3. The application stands disposed of accordingly.

1. This is an appeal under section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 impugning the judgment dated 29.05.2023 passed in LAC No. 71/2019 in respect of the Award No. 7/2005-06 pertaining to the land acquired of This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 21/10/2023 at 00:32:22 Village Pooth Khurd vide Award dated 27th June, 2005.
2. Issue notice.

Dharambir Singh (Deceased) Through Lrs vs Union Of India & Anr on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170045975/
1 3. Notice is accepted by Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak, learned Standing Counsel appearing for the Union of India and Mr. R.K. Dhawan, learned Standing Counsel appearing on behalf of Delhi Development Authority (DDA).

4. Learned Standing Counsel for UOI submits that the Land Acquisition Collector has determined the market value of land acquired vide the said Award @ 15,70,000/- per acre for block "A" and Rs 14,00,000/- per acre for land falling in B" block.

He further submits that in the present appeal, the appellant seeks further enhancement of compensation of Rs.50,000/- per bigha over and above the amount passed in the reference award, besides other statutory benefits including interest on solatium.

5. Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pathak further informs that the issue raised in the present appeal is similar to the one raised in L.A. APP No. 226/2018 titled Randhir Singh v Union of India & Anr, which was listed before this Court on 14.08.2019 and was admitted on the same day and is now listed in the category of 'Regular Matters'.
6. Admit.
7. List the present appeal in due course in the category of 'Regular Matters' along with L.A. APP No.
226/2018.
